listing.name: Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) — ReCarbon (retronative)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream early development, playable in parts, unreleased. Fifteen-minute free roam and one completed AI career race with restart progress reported; repeated route, keyboard controls, physics/frame-pacing and picture/audio acceptance remain pending. Physical controller unverified; unexplained stalls. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own NeedForSpeedCarbon Xbox360 disc extracted to game/files/default.xex. Title454107EC; installer full-file SHA256 manifest is retained upstream, exact source revision/digest not transcribed here.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: AppleSilicon source route: setup_tools.sh, survey.sh, CMake native ReCarbon build, then --install own image. App packaging documented but no public release. Current bundled libraries require macOS27; no downloaded player package asserted.
